collections.title: Traditional Juttis Collection
collections.subtitle: Handcrafted Comfort for Everyday Elegance
collections.introduction: Juttis have been a favourite for all time in traditional Indian footwear. With intricate embroidery, bright colours and cultural appeal, they remain one of the most popular options among fashionable people. Gulbhahar, founded by Monica Gulati, showcases the craftsmanship of creating juttis. Each collection has a blending heritage with contemporary sophistication. Every pair is designed to be extremely comfortable, durable and stylish.
